title: v0.99.88 — Extension Host/Runtime Service Boundary
description: Frozen from v0.99.87 W4. Isolate concrete Runtime provider/package services from Extension contexts. Findings MA-02–MA-05. Broad gates after W2 and W4.

waves.title: v0.99.88 W0 — Extension context characterization and re-baselining
waves.body:
## Goal
Characterize extension context construction, provider-registry consumers, session/resume/GSD/dynamic-load/failure behavior. No production change.

## Gate
Focused Extension/Registry/GSD + Fast + independent review.

## Acceptance
Closed session-type claim reverified; all remaining registry consumers classified.

waves.title: v0.99.88 W1 — Neutral Extension Host Service Protocol
waves.body:
## Goal
Define minimal capability-oriented registry host operations and runtime adapter; preserve ctx facade.

## Gate
Contracts + registry + dynamic-require + Arch + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Host protocol is narrower than the concrete Runtime surface and compatibility holds.

waves.title: v0.99.88 W2 — Isolate Provider Registry Service
waves.body:
## Goal
Remove direct Runtime provider-registry import from extensions/context.rkt and delegate through injected host service.

## Gate
Arch + Broad + negative exception probe + review.

## Acceptance
Runtime import and exception removed with differential behavior preserved.

waves.title: v0.99.88 W3 — Isolate ext-package-manager
waves.body:
## Goal
Move concrete package lifecycle access behind host/wiring adapter; do not move install/filesystem logic into util.

## Gate
Package + Security + Arch + Fast + review.

## Acceptance
Coupling removed or replaced by a narrow evidence-backed waiver.

waves.title: v0.99.88 W4 — Decide TUI extension exceptions and release
waves.body:
## Goal
Decide dialog-api, ui-surface, and widget-lifecycle bridges individually and publish v0.99.88.

## Gate
Broad + Arch + Security + Smoke + Release + independent review.

## Acceptance
All five old exceptions are closed or newly evidence-decided; none expired; release verified.
